list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Discrete Nd–Nd–Dy trinuclear framework. The Dy³⁺ site is coordinated by four THF molecules, an S₂ group, and a terminal N atom of the S₂N₂ ligand; Fig. 1 depicts the molecular structure.

synthesis.procedure: To a mixture of [ (NdI)₃N₂(CH₃CN)₂ ] (0.252 mmol, 0.227 g) and DyI₃(THF)₃ (0.24 mmol, 0.160 g), sulfur (1.55 mmol, 0.050 g) and condensed THF (25 mL) were added. The mixture was stirred in an ultrasonic bath for 4 h at 60 °C. After centrifugation, the solution was decanted, evaporated to 20 mL, and cooled at 0 °C for 10 h. The crystals were washed with THF at 30 °C to separate the product crystals, then dried in vacuo.
synthesis.temperature: 60 °C reaction; cooled at 0 °C; washed with THF at 30 °C
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solution decanted from precipitate, evaporated to 20 mL and cooled at 0 °C for 10 h. Crystals washed with THF at 30 °C and dried in vacuo.

properties.summary: Room-temperature magnetic moments agree with the expected Nd₂Yb contribution, indicating no intramolecular magnetic exchange. The same crystalline cluster was obtained using either YbI₂ or YbI₃; the article does not report optical measurements for this compound.

source_locations.location: CCDC catalog metadata; synthesis section, lines 89–95

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Discrete Nd–Nd–Yb trinuclear framework, isostructural with the Nd–Nd–Dy cluster. The inserted Ln³⁺ site is described as coordinated by four THF molecules, an S₂ group, and a terminal N atom of the S₂N₂ ligand; Fig. 1 shows the Yb analogue.

synthesis.procedure: The Yb cluster was prepared from [(NdI)₃N₂(CH₃CN)₂] (0.405 mmol, 0.374 g), YbI₂(THF)₄ (0.154 mmol, 0.110 g) and sulfur (1.87 mmol, 0.060 g) in THF (25 mL). The article states it was obtained similarly from these reagents. It also reports a separate YbI₃ route using [(NdI)₃N₂(CH₃CN)₂] (0.394 mmol, 364 mg), sulfur (1.56 mmol, 50 mg), and YbI₃ (0.132 mmol, 124 mg).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: For the YbI₂ route the product was isolated as red crystals. Specific work-up details are not repeated; preparation is stated to be similar to the Dy procedure. The YbI₃ route is likewise stated to be carried out similarly.
synthesis.yield: YbI₂ route: 0.123 g (42% based on YbI₂(THF)₄). YbI₃ route: 137 mg (54.6% based on YbI₃).
